```python
import math
from gurobipy import *

def solve_problem():
    m = Model("VRPTW")
    m.setParam('TimeLimit', 300)

    # --- Data ---
    n_customers = 7
    n_vehicles = 4
    Q = 50  # vehicle capacity
    vehicle_fixed_cost = 100.0
    depot = [50, 50]
    customers = [[62, 39], [31, 49], [38, 51], [37, 73], [57, 34], [80, 56], [19, 92]]
    demands = [7, 20, 20, 14, 15, 10, 25]
    time_windows = [[0, 301], [26, 87], [42, 124], [16, 108], [47, 122], [16, 68], [51, 123], [47, 135]]
    service_times = [9, 13, 13, 14, 5, 6, 10]

    # Node 0 = depot, nodes 1..N = customers
    N = n_customers
    nodes = list(range(N + 1))
    cust_nodes = list(range(1, N + 1))

    # Coordinates: index 0 = depot, 1..N = customers
    coords = [depot] + customers

    # COMPUTE distance matrix from coordinates
    dist = {}
    for i in nodes:
        for j in nodes:
            if i != j:
                dist[(i,j)] = math.sqrt(
                    (coords[i][0]-coords[j][0])**2 +
                    (coords[i][1]-coords[j][1])**2)

    # Service time by node (depot = 0)
    svc = [0] + service_times

    # Big-M for time linking
    T_max = time_windows[0][1]
    max_svc = max(service_times)
    max_dist = max(dist.values())
    M = T_max + max_svc + max_dist + 1

    # --- Variables ---
    # Arc variables (binary)
    x = {}
    for i in nodes:
        for j in nodes:
            if i != j:
                x[(i,j)] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"Arc_{i}_{j}")

    # Load variables (MTZ subtour elimination)
    u = {}
    for i in cust_nodes:
        u[i] = m.addVar(lb=demands[i-1], ub=Q, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Load_{i}")

    # Time variables
    t = {}
    for i in nodes:
        a, b = time_windows[i]
        t[i] = m.addVar(lb=a, ub=b, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Time_{i}")
    # Fix depot departure to time 0
    t[0].ub = 0.0

    # --- Objective ---
    # Minimize travel distance + vehicle fixed costs
    obj = quicksum(dist[(i,j)] * x[(i,j)] for i in nodes for j in nodes if i != j)
    obj += quicksum(vehicle_fixed_cost * x[(0,j)] for j in cust_nodes)
    m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

    # --- Constraints ---
    # 1. Each customer has exactly one outgoing arc
    for i in cust_nodes:
        m.addConstr(
            quicksum(x[(i,j)] for j in nodes if j != i) == 1,
            name=f"VisitOut_C{i}")

    # 2. Each customer has exactly one incoming arc
    for j in cust_nodes:
        m.addConstr(
            quicksum(x[(i,j)] for i in nodes if i != j) == 1,
            name=f"VisitIn_C{j}")

    # 3. At most K vehicles leave the depot
    m.addConstr(
        quicksum(x[(0,j)] for j in cust_nodes) <= n_vehicles,
        name="VehicleLimit")

    # 4. MTZ subtour elimination
    for i in cust_nodes:
        for j in cust_nodes:
            if i != j:
                m.addConstr(
                    u[i] - u[j] + Q * x[(i,j)] <= Q - demands[j-1],
                    name=f"MTZ_{i}_{j}")

    # 5. Time linking: if arc (i,j) is used, arrival at j >= departure from i
    for j in cust_nodes:
        for i in nodes:
            if i != j:
                m.addConstr(
                    t[i] - t[j] + M * x[(i,j)] <= M - svc[i] - dist[(i,j)],
                    name=f"TimeLink_{i}_{j}")

    m.optimize()
    return m
```

Subject: Routing and Scheduling Plan for the Upcoming Delivery Cycle

Overview
We will execute a single planning horizon in which a fleet of identical vehicles dispatches from our central depot to deliver to a defined set of customers and then returns to the depot. All vehicles will depart at time 0, and each vehicle will make exactly one continuous trip before returning to the depot prior to the end of the planning horizon.

Delivery Challenge
Our task is to assign customers to vehicles and sequence each vehicle’s stops so that every customer is visited exactly once within their acceptable delivery window. The routes must satisfy vehicle capacity limits, accommodate each customer’s unloading/service time, and ensure timely return to the depot. We must balance the cost of deploying vehicles against the travel distance required to meet service commitments.

Operating Rules and Constraints
- Start and end times:
  - All vehicles depart the depot at time 0.
  - Each vehicle must return to the depot by the close of the planning horizon indicated for the depot.
- Single trip per vehicle:
  - Each deployed vehicle leaves once, visits its assigned sequence of customers, and returns to the depot without intermediate trips or reloading.
- Customer time windows:
  - Service at each customer must begin within that customer’s earliest and latest allowable times.
  - If a vehicle arrives early, it must wait until the window opens; arrivals after the latest time are not allowed.
- Service times:
  - Each customer requires a specified service/unloading duration.
  - Departure from a customer occurs after the arrival time plus the service time (or the window opening time plus the service time if waiting was required).
- Capacity:
  - The total demand of customers assigned to a vehicle’s route must not exceed that vehicle’s carrying capacity at any point on the route.
  - No splitting of a single customer’s demand across multiple vehicles is allowed.
- Travel time and distance:
  - Locations are defined by map coordinates.
  - Travel time between any two locations equals the straight-line distance between those coordinates, with an implicit speed of 1. This makes travel time numerically equal to travel distance.
- Costs:
  - Each vehicle used incurs a fixed deployment cost.
  - Total cost for any plan is the sum of travel distance across all routes plus the fixed cost for each vehicle we deploy.
  - We may choose to deploy fewer than the maximum number of vehicles if it reduces overall cost while still meeting service constraints.

Goal
Develop a feasible set of vehicle routes and stop sequences that:
- Visits every customer exactly once and within their time window,
- Respects vehicle capacity and accounts for all service times,
- Ensures all vehicles return to the depot before the depot’s closing time,
- Minimizes the combined total of travel distance and vehicle deployment costs.

Deliverables
- A route plan for each deployed vehicle, including the sequence of customers served and the expected arrival, waiting (if any), service, and departure times at each stop.
- Confirmation that no route exceeds capacity and that all time windows are met.
- A cost summary covering total distance traveled and fixed deployment costs.

- Depot closing time: 301

  - C4: (37, 73)
  - C5: (57, 34)
  - C6: (80, 56)
  - C7: (19, 92)
- Customer demands: Customer Demands:
  - C1: 7 units
  - C2: 20 units
  - C3: 20 units
  - C4: 14 units
  - C5: 15 units
  - C6: 10 units
  - C7: 25 units
- Customer time windows: Customer Time Windows [earliest, latest]:
  - C1: [26, 87]
  - C2: [42, 124]
  - C3: [16, 108]
  - C4: [47, 122]
  - C5: [16, 68]
  - C6: [51, 123]
  - C7: [47, 135]
- Customer service times: Service Times (minutes at customer):
  - C1: 9
